title: Natural Justice Bar Exception
description: Proceedings complying with the procedure laid down in sub-sections (1) and (2) of section 38 cannot be called in question in any court on natural justice grounds

content.general_rule: Proceedings before the District Commission shall be conducted in accordance with the procedure laid down in sub-sections (1) and (2) of section 38
content.exception: No proceedings complying with the procedure laid down in sub-sections (1) and (2) shall be called in question in any court on the ground that the principles of natural justice have not been complied with
conditions: the proceedings comply with the procedure laid down in sub-sections (1) and (2) of section 38
